reporting_row_proposal.required_original_policy: All declared outcomes, failures, costs and source/matched protocol distinctions remain visible; no survivor-only inference or invented refit.
reporting_row_proposal.implementation_status: proposed expanded reporting binding, not executable or adopted

decisions.candidate: Treat the complete 6460-fit matrix as exploratory and publish every prescribed paired effect without confirmatory win labels; nominate at most one exact candidate/setting for a separate reviewed confirmation study.
decisions.reason: The old 226-contrast family is an ancestor 2,480 policy and its ten-pair two-sided sign-flip/Holm threshold is unattainable even with perfect signs.
decisions.alternative_requiring_new_review: Define a smaller prospective primary family or another justified joint/hierarchical estimand, with valid units, assumptions and multiplicity allocation before outcome-guided selection.
decisions.must_not_do: Reuse226 as if it covered the expanded matrix, split families after seeing outcomes, or switch tests because SD appears small.

candidate.coverage: marginal and approximate; no simultaneous or population-generalization claim

decisions.scope: Node rows combine split/training variation on one graph; OGB/link rows concern training variation on fixed official data. No pooling of presets, routes, I4 bodies or dependent queries as independent training trials.
decisions.source: Retained ancestor interval convention offered for review, not unilaterally adopted for the expanded matrix.
decisions.missingness_candidate: Publish all planned row statuses; withhold complete-preset intervals/tests when required pairs are missing rather than presenting survivor-only inference. Capped trajectories retain their score and unresolved convergence label.

decisions.existing_candidate: Existing confirmation proposal: at most one method/setting with positive mean VALID(candidate - max(M1,G0,I4)) across all 10 development cohorts, exact ID tie-break and no eligible positive candidate means no promotion.
review_choices: Freeze candidate eligibility and distinguish scientific controls from promotable recipes.
Resolve cross-task/preset screening utility; native metrics share 0–1 bounds but not identical practical meaning.
Reconcile prospective confirmation nomination with the parent's no_cross_preset_winner_selection flag and complete-preset reporting.
Decide whether to require a practically meaningful minimum effect and its units; no value selected here.
decisions.strongest_baseline_maximum: Screening statistic only; never a fitted or served oracle baseline.

existing_candidate.claim: Probability of a strict positive paired native-metric difference exceeds one half against each of M1,G0,I4, conditional on the reviewed setting/sampling law.
existing_candidate.test: Three one-sided exact sign/binomial component tests, joint intersection-union p=max(component p), all components at alpha .05.
existing_candidate.ties_or_unresolved: Non-wins in each fixed 20 denominator; quality-only descriptive statistics retain separate missingness.

required_unresolved_fields: Exact 20 seeds and audit against development, earlier pilot/check streams and independent-body offsets.
For a node candidate: fixed-split repeat law versus specified new split/training law and the corresponding estimand/independence assumptions.
Exact candidate, all source/controller/evaluator/readout hashes, primary endpoint and practical-effect/failure/tie rules.
Reviewed budget and human authorization for any additional confirmation fits.
decisions.new_data_claim: Fresh RNG seeds cannot erase historical TEST exposure or establish transfer to unseen datasets.

decisions.candidate: Create an append-only exposure/decision ledger before any confirmation or TEST release, including known, absent-evidence and unknown historical access.
decisions.finding: No consolidated ledger or confirmation seed registry was located among the reviewed E source/metadata filenames; this is not proof of no prior exposure.
decisions.development_disclosure: All existing 24-fit ingredient, 3-fit private-BN, selected-VALID diagnostics and 9-fit follow-up choices belong to development history, outside 6,460. No progress or outcomes of the 9-fit study were read for this review.

candidate_sequence: Complete all own checkpoint selections using the declared whole VALID procedure.
Freeze scientific candidate/family and exact served predictor before heldout outcomes are exposed.
Bind each selected checkpoint, method dependencies, native topology, full official query/role population, evaluator and runtime/resource qualification.
Obtain actual VALID parity evidence for the selected-state reconstruction without opening TEST.
Obtain real human authorization for the exact final TEST request; a JSON boolean alone does not authenticate approval.
Persist the access, export, source/input/state hashes and complete result; do not tune or reselect from TEST.
scope_limits: No fallback current/final/recovery checkpoint when an own selected state is missing.
Native Collab TRAIN+VALID TEST topology is explicit; TEST query edges cannot enter it.
Resolve source diagnostic/RNG fidelity through a qualified closed-TEST emulation or an explicit adaptation; this proposal grants no diagnostic TEST reads.
Verify new extensions and learned actual readouts are supported by final serving; stripping an extension is not a valid reconstruction.
If the human later authorizes all exploratory TEST results, report the full matrix as exploratory and do not revise the frozen primary claim.

decisions.candidate: Attach the reviewed reporting/statistics/access registry and measured resource/cost receipts to the eventual current-runtime dispatcher binding.
facts: All 6,460 source descriptors are prepared in v3; that is distinct from runtime/resource/reporting admission.
270 I4 exports and all same-bank readouts are charged as analysis/inference, not new model fits.
Available pilot measurements transfer only to 60 exactly matching fit intentions in the current cost catalogue; no campaign ETA is established.
Source-mismatched timings and smoke allocator peaks are not full-run resource measurements.
Only the allocation is authorized; future 77 placements are not available capacity.

next_review_output: Root-selected choices and unresolved dispositions in a separately versioned registry, with scientific claim/endpoint/family/sampling/access/budget hashes and real authorization references. This package is not that registry.
